comments.author: Jean
comments.body: can you ease the fatigue from frugality use, with the marching skill? or marching is only for land

comments.author: Meng Meng
comments.body: Hmm in a way yeah, although I doubt it'll has major effect.

comments.author: Misun
comments.body: is this a basic skill that everyone should have like account,steering,storage,etc... or can I pass on it?

comments.author: Pirotess
comments.body: I'd say a basic skill, especially if you have a big crew or a galley: in that case is almost mandatory.

comments.author: Sylvia
comments.body: what is best way to grind this skill? wear +items?

comments.author: Beatrice
comments.body: does the crew amount effect this skill?

comments.author: Cornelia
comments.body: The only way to grind this skill is simply sail around, or at least port sit while this is activated. It goes up slowly however so be prepared to spend a long time out in the waters. Not sure if the amount of crew you have affects its skill proficiency though.

comments.author: Hans
comments.body: Make sure you're in a job that favors the skill when trying to rank it.

comments.author: Laurencio
comments.body: For me it only lowers food usage. Do higher ranks lower water usage too?

comments.author: Francine
comments.body: there are places that consumes more food than water and vice versa. so typically even with higher ranks you can notice that there are times food goes down fast or water goes down fast. it all depends on the area you're sailing to.

comments.author: Ming Mei
comments.body: at rank 14 with 28 sailors in my btc , they consume 1 unit of water and food each 2 days

comments.author: BonnyLass
comments.body: If you plan to leave this skill grinding while port sitting, learn from my mistake: your fatigue will keep rising, of course, and if it maxes out, your sailors start dropping like flies, until none remain and you're shipwrecked. Oops! It's always the little things that get you.

comments.author: BIakeC
comments.body: The description of Frugality in game has been modified/fixed to make more sense. It now says "Reduces the consumption of Water and Food provided to Sailors as well as the cost of hiring Sailors."

wiki: This skill can be added to any aide by unlocking it at the Aide Academy -- see Sagres for details
